entries.title: Chained Echoes
entries.definitive_edition: Chained Echoes on Windows PC with Ashes of Elrant DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Ashes of Elrant DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version has the complete current route with Ashes of Elrant, the best capture path, and no sourced platform-exclusive content missing from PC. Console and portable versions are valid but not more complete.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Chained Echoes on Steam, GOG, or the Xbox PC/Microsoft Store route for Windows PC, then add the Ashes of Elrant DLC for the current complete story route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Ashes of Elrant DLC available.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Ashes of Elrant is available across PC and console platforms; PC is the best capture route and does not miss exclusive content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ashes of Elrant is story DLC set before the final fight, not a separate game entry or remaster.
